shortDescription: US President Donald Trump on Monday said he thinks someone other than Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy should negotiate on behalf of the country as it seeks to end the war with Russia."Maybe it's time for Zelenskiy to get somebody else to negotiate," Trump told reporters.
